title: Special Repair & Civil maintenance of Lighthouse Tower, Office building, IQ and Staff quarters etc at Kalingapatnam Lighthouse - reg.
summary: E-tender for special repairs and civil maintenance of the lighthouse tower, office building, inspection quarters and staff quarters at Kalingapatnam Lighthouse, Andhra Pradesh, issued by the Kolkata Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

sites.name: Kalingapatnam Lighthouse
sites.work: Special repair and civil maintenance of tower, office building, IQ and staff quarters

scope.item: Special Repair & Civil maintenance of Lighthouse Tower, Office building, IQ and Staff quarters etc

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata, valid three months from technical bid opening; exemption not allowed; original EMD to reach office on or before last date of bid submission.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration of appropriate class in appropriate category (building civil work) with Central Govt department/undertaking/autonomous body or State Govt
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%; value updated at 7% simple per annum
Similar works: repairs & maintenance or construction of any type of building (RCC or masonry)
Valid PAN card and GST registration
Notarized affidavit (2025) of not being blacklisted or debarred
Undertaking that price bid is unconditional
Signed Tender Acceptance letter; other documents per Section VI

unreadable: Hindi text layer uses mis-mapped glyphs; English portions complete

notes: NIT only (printed pages 3-6); no reference number, issue date or BOQ. Bid document download 30/01/2025 11:00 to 19/02/2025 15:00; technical bid opening 20/02/2025 16:00.
